scope: Static input/model/metric path checks plus eight fixed source-validation runtime replays; no training or parameter changes
verdict: No concrete external input/evaluator inconsistency identified in inspected supported paths

checks.finding: Source validation and external evaluation share GeoPRRV2Dataset._sample: cv2 IMREAD_COLOR, BGR to RGB, float32 /255, ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. External augment=False.

Both v7 paths perform direct cv2 INTER_LINEAR resize768 square with no letterbox. Source train/validation rows have image_path plus GT dial_bbox and are cropped before resize. External roi_path makes bbox=None and consumes the complete supplied native ROI. This obeys the model ROI interface; source tight annotation crop versus external existing crop can still be a real domain shift.

Original RoleTriangleReader, strict full497-state best64 loading, seed20262020, association full, data768/192 and7461316parameters; fixed8 source runtime replay reproduces saved predictions with max normalized difference2.980232238769531e-7.

Source validation and external use eval, inference_mode, configured backbone AMP andFP32 heads. Source sets deterministic CuDNN flags while external defaults differ; the fixed8 current-path source replay nevertheless agrees within2.980232238769531e-7 normalized, with alltargets exact. No large runtime discrepancy was observed.

External reuses original validation_rows/validation_summary and original model reading. CircularProgressPushforward retains all circular mass, uniformly transports zero-span atoms, and clips atoms/progress internally as in training; external adds no readout fitting or clipping. Target converts physical(value-start)/(end-start) toFP32 and absolute normalized error; percentFS scales error by100. Zero values are processed directly, with no truthiness fallback.

Source validation constructs H/span/field labels but calls model(batch[image]) only. External require_geometry=False, only image/y/id/group/failure retained, forward only image. Group IDs and scalar labels remain scoring metadata. Source GT bbox is an upstream ROI selection and should remain disclosed separately from a GT matrix or endpoints passed to model.

Remote input manifests contain only sample_id and roi_path. Industrial index records1395/1395 workbook-embedded ROI decoded pixel matches,1248 byte matches and147 differing containers with decoded pixel match. All source_kind descriptions identify embedded native ROIs, not full frames. RF100 index maps native existing ROI to source jpg and crop coordinates. These are recorded metadata assertions; this diagnosis did not decode or compare historical original Windows ROI bytes.

Old unified reader consumes whole supplied ROI pixels, RGB ImageNet normalized, but resizes to256 using AREA for downsample and LINEAR otherwise. It derives its SARN/support/H from image pixels and has multiple expert/readout routes. These are part of the old model. Copying them into v7 would change its trained inference path. Old clean explicitly sets SARN active=false.
